name: Higuera de Calatrava (Spain)
description: Crimson field with a central pale divided horizontally white over green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Higuera de Calatrava (a cross of Calatrava on yellow) and the green with a yellow tower.
history: Municipal flag of Higuera de Calatrava; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: central pale divided white above and green below
Higuera de Calatrava arms — cross of Calatrava on yellow
